name: WellInterventionWorkoverPlanner
tagline: Rank every workover candidate, book every rig and prove every uplift – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete well intervention and workover planning app for Power Apps and Power Pages: rank candidates by risked gain against cost, approve them against a PI and payback hurdle, an approval limit and a program budget, book rigs and units without double bookings, follow the jobs on the well and run the post-job uplift look-back by job type. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Risked gain vs cost chart with the hurdle line
12-month PI, payback and budget cut-off ranking
Approval limit and below-hurdle justification rules
Rig and unit Gantt with clash detection
Post-job test wait and success threshold
Look-back by job type: success rate, cost per bopd, actual payback
Bulk defer / reject, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and OnSave / OnCreate / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
Phone layout with bottom view bar and unit agenda
